title: Add a Hebrew/RTL locale test variant for the Lifetime Marking screens (TQ-3)
why: The settings feature's own convention -- established in this same batch by curriculum_settings_screen_l1_test.dart and curriculum_settings_and_change_password_l1_test.dart, both of which pump a Locale('he') variant and assert Directionality.rtl -- is that key screens get an RTL smoke test (TQ-3). None of the 3 files that pump LifetimeMarkingScreen/LifetimeCurriculumMarkingScreen (a 986-line screen with hierarchical drill-down navigation) ever set `locale:` on their MaterialApp, so Hebrew string rendering and RTL layout for this screen are completely unverified by the automated suite despite being explicitly load-bearing elsewhere in this same feature.
recommendation: Add a Locale('he') smoke-render test (renders without crash, Directionality.rtl) to lifetime_marking_screen_test.dart at minimum, matching the pattern already used in curriculum_settings_screen_l1_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: At least one Locale('he') test exists for LifetimeMarkingScreen and asserts Directionality.rtl.

corrections: Slight overstatement: of the two comparison files cited as both asserting Directionality.rtl, only curriculum_settings_screen_l1_test.dart actually does; curriculum_settings_and_change_password_l1_test.dart pumps Locale('he') but only smoke-renders (no Directionality assertion found). Doesn't change the core finding — target files still have zero Hebrew coverage.
